docs.summary:
GLSL that runs on the GPU outside of drawing. A `.compute` file declares its entry points with `#pragma kernel Name X Y Z`, the thread group size (Y and Z default to 1), and each one is a plain `void Name()` function reading `gl_GlobalInvocationID` and friends. Storage blocks and images need no binding layout, Graphite assigns them and binds by name.

Values set with [`SetFloat`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.ComputeShader~SetFloat) and the like apply to every kernel, buffers and textures are set per kernel. A dispatch runs at once, ahead of anything submitted later, so a buffer read afterwards sees its results. For work inside the frame, write a Graphite RenderFeature or RenderProvider instead.
Whether compute can run, which needs a device.

Frees native resources and anything derived from the payload. Runs when the asset unloads, before a refill and when a runtime asset is disposed. The database resets every field to its shell value afterwards.
